scenarios.name: Battle of Wolf 359 — The Fall of the Fleet
scenarios.description: The Borg Cube emerges at Wolf 359 and encounters a Starfleet task force of 40 ships. Despite a valiant defense, the fleet is overwhelmed and assimilated. Only the USS Enterprise-D arrives in time to witness the aftermath and rescue survivors.
scenarios.map: Space combat at the Wolf 359 star system

objective.starfleet: Delay the Borg Cube long enough for reinforcements to arrive. Protect the civilian transports.
objective.borg: Assimilate the Starfleet fleet and continue toward the Alpha Quadrant core worlds.

special_rules: Borg shields adapt to each weapon type after the first volley — subsequent volleys of the same type deal reduced damage
Starfleet ships can be assimilated when destroyed, joining the Borg fleet
Enterprise-D arrives after Round 4 if the scenario allows
Civilian transports must be protected; their loss is an automatic Starfleet failure

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Survive until reinforcements arrive (Round 8) OR force the Borg Cube to retreat
victory_conditions.borg_victory: Assimilate 30+ Starfleet ships OR destroy all Starfleet combatants

scenarios.name: Enterprise vs. Klingon Hunter — The Omega Directive
scenarios.description: The USS Enterprise-E discovers a Klingon battle cruiser, the IKS Hunter, secretly searching for Omega molecules — a substance so dangerous that its existence is classified. Picard must decide whether to follow the Omega Directive or intervene.
scenarios.map: Space combat near a remote star system

objective.starfleet: Prevent the Klingons from weaponizing Omega molecules without violating the Omega Directive's secrecy requirements.
objective.klingon: Secure the Omega molecules and eliminate the Enterprise before it reports back to Starfleet.

starfleet_forces: Full bridge crew: Picard, Riker, Data, Worf, Troi, La Forge, Crusher

special_rules: Omega molecules can destroy entire star systems if weaponized
Picard knows the Omega Directive; the Klingons do not know Picard knows
Diplomatic resolution is possible if both captains can be reasoned with
Worf has divided loyalties between Starfleet and the Klingons

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Neutralize the Omega threat without revealing the Omega Directive
victory_conditions.klingon_victory: Secure Omega molecules and destroy or disable the Enterprise

scenarios.name: Battle of Cardassia — The End of the Dominion War
scenarios.description: The final battle of the Dominion War. A combined Federation-Klingon-Romulan fleet assaults Cardassia Prime to end the Dominion's grip on the Alpha Quadrant. Gul Dukat, empowered by the Pah-wraiths, commands the defense from the Negh'Var.

objective.alliance: Destroy the Dominion forces and liberate Cardassia Prime.
objective.dominion: Defend Cardassia Prime and destroy the allied fleet.

special_rules: Dukat's Pah-wraith empowerment gives the Negh'Var enhanced weapons and shields
Damar's Cardassian forces may defect to the alliance if morale breaks
Dominion reinforcements can arrive through the Bajoran wormhole
The Founders may call for a ceasefire at any time, ending the battle

victory_conditions.alliance_victory: Destroy the Negh'Var AND eliminate Dominion forces in system
victory_conditions.dominion_victory: Destroy the allied fleet OR hold Cardassia Prime for 8 rounds

scenarios.name: Voyager's Journey Home — The Delta Quadrant
scenarios.description: The USS Voyager is stranded 70,000 light-years from home in the Delta Quadrant. Captain Janeway and her crew must navigate hostile territory, encounter new species, and find a way home against impossible odds.

objective.voyager: Navigate the Delta Quadrant, survive encounters with hostile species, and find a way home to the Alpha Quadrant.

voyager_forces: Crew: Janeway, Chakotay, Tuvok, Paris, Torres, Kim, The Doctor, Seven of Nine (later)
Maquis crew members (initial tension with Starfleet crew)

special_rules: Each game session represents one episode of the journey
Encounters include: Hirogen hunters, Kazon raiders, Vidiians, Borg, Ocampa, Holographic Voyager
Seven of Nine joins the crew mid-campaign, providing Borg knowledge
The crew must manage resources: food, fuel, and spare parts are limited
Shortcuts home (wormholes, transwarp) are rare and often come with a price

victory_conditions.voyager_victory: Return to the Alpha Quadrant within a reasonable timeframe
victory_conditions.defeat: Voyager is destroyed or the crew is assimilated by the Borg

scenarios.name: Klingon Boarding Action — Honor in Battle
scenarios.description: A Klingon Bird-of-Prey has boarded the USS Enterprise. Klingon warriors, armed with bat'leths, move through the corridors seeking Captain Kirk. The Enterprise crew must defend their ship and either repel the boarders or negotiate a resolution.
scenarios.map: USS Enterprise corridors and key rooms (bridge, engineering, sickbay)

objective.starfleet: Repel the Klingon boarding party and secure the ship. Capture or eliminate the boarders.
objective.klingon: Capture or kill Captain Kirk to prove honor. Escape with the prize or die trying.

starfleet_forces: Key crew members: Kirk, Spock, McCoy, Scotty, Sulu, Uhura

special_rules: Klingons fight for honor; they will challenge Kirk to single combat
Enterprise crew initially uses stun settings; can switch to injure if necessary
Scotty can seal off sections of the ship to contain the boarders
Spock can use a mind meld to understand the Klingon commander's intentions

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Repel all Klingon boarders and secure the ship
victory_conditions.klingon_victory: Capture or kill Captain Kirk and escape in the Bird-of-Prey

scenarios.name: First Contact — The Prime Directive Test
scenarios.description: The crew discovers a pre-warp civilization on the verge of a major technological breakthrough. An accident threatens to cause a catastrophe, but intervening would violate the Prime Directive. The crew must find a way to prevent disaster without revealing themselves.
scenarios.map: Pre-warp planet surface with cities and natural features

objective.starfleet: Prevent the catastrophe without violating the Prime Directive. The crew must find creative solutions that appear natural to the indigenous population.

starfleet_forces: Away team: Captain, Science Officer, Security Officer, Medical Officer
Limited equipment: tricorders, mediscanners, phasers (stun only)
Prime Directive constraints: no direct interference with pre-warp civilization

special_rules: The Prime Directive forbids direct interference with pre-warp civilizations
The crew must use indirect methods: manipulating events, using environmental factors, or working through indigenous intermediaries
If the crew is discovered, they must erase memories and leave immediately
Multiple solutions are possible; creativity is rewarded

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Prevent the catastrophe without the indigenous population knowing Starfleet intervened
victory_conditions.failure: The catastrophe occurs OR the Prime Directive is violated

scenarios.name: Romulan Cloak Chase — Through the Neutral Zone
scenarios.description: A Romulan Warbird has crossed the Neutral Zone, violating the Federation-Romulan treaty. The pursuing Starfleet ship must track and intercept the cloaked Warbird without crossing into Romulan space and starting a war.
scenarios.map: Space combat near the Federation-Romulan Neutral Zone

objective.starfleet: Track and intercept the Romulan Warbird. Gather evidence of the treaty violation without firing first.
objective.romulan: Evade capture and deliver your mission objective. Deny any treaty violation.

starfleet_forces: Starfleet pursuit ship (Constitution, Galaxy, or Sovereign class)
Orders: do not fire first, do not cross the Neutral Zone
romulan_forces: Mission objective: deliver data, plant a device, or extract an agent

special_rules: The Romulan Warbird is cloaked; it appears on sensors only when it fires or chooses to decloak
Starfleet cannot cross the Neutral Zone without authorization
If Starfleet fires first, it's an act of war
The Romulans have a time limit to complete their mission

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Force the Warbird to decloak and gather evidence of the treaty violation
victory_conditions.romulan_victory: Complete the mission objective and escape back into Romulan space

scenarios.name: Defense of Deep Space 9 — The Dominion Assault
scenarios.description: The Dominion launches a massive assault on Deep Space 9. Captain Sisko must defend the station with the USS Defiant and whatever reinforcements can arrive through the wormhole or from nearby systems.
scenarios.map: Space combat around Deep Space 9 and the Bajoran wormhole

objective.federation: Defend Deep Space 9 against the Dominion assault. Hold the station until reinforcements arrive.
objective.dominion: Capture or destroy Deep Space 9 and control the wormhole.

federation_forces: Reinforcements may arrive through the wormhole (Gamma Quadrant allies)

special_rules: DS9 has limited defensive weapons but can repair and resupply ships
The wormhole can provide reinforcements from the Gamma Quadrant (Prophets' allies)
Jem'Hadar ships are heavily armed but vulnerable when deprived of Ketracel-white
Station personnel can be evacuated if the situation becomes critical

victory_conditions.federation_victory: Hold DS9 for 6 rounds OR destroy the Dominion fleet
victory_conditions.dominion_victory: Destroy DS9 OR capture it with the wormhole under Dominion control

scenarios.name: Assault on the Borg Cube — Regeneration One
scenarios.description: Voyager encounters a damaged Borg Cube in the Delta Quadrant. Seven of Nine recognizes the opportunity to learn about Borg weaknesses. The crew must board the Cube, gather intelligence, and escape before the Borg recover.
scenarios.map: Interior of a damaged Borg Cube

objective.voyager: Board the Borg Cube, gather intelligence about Borg technology and weaknesses, and escape before the Cube's defenses recover.

voyager_forces: Away team: Janeway, Seven of Nine, Paris, Torres, The Doctor
Equipment: phasers, tricorders, isolinear chips for data extraction
Seven of Nine can interface with Borg systems but risks re-assimilation

special_rules: The Cube is damaged but still has active defenses
Borg drones will attempt to assimilate the away team
Seven of Nine can hack Borg systems but each interface roll risks a Complication
The Cube's defenses recover over time; the team has a limited window
Data extracted from the Cube can provide lasting benefits to Voyager

victory_conditions.voyager_victory: Extract significant Borg intelligence and escape with all team members
victory_conditions.failure: Team members are assimilated OR the team is trapped on the Cube

scenarios.name: Attack on Vulcan — The Nero's Vengeance
scenarios.description: The Romulan mining vessel Nero, displaced through a wormhole, arrives in the 23rd century and destroys Vulcan in revenge for Spock's actions. The USS Enterprise under Captain Kirk must pursue Nero through a wormhole to prevent further attacks.
scenarios.map: Space combat at Vulcan, then through a wormhole to Nero's mining site

objective.starfleet: Pursue Nero through the wormhole and stop him from destroying Earth.
objective.nero: Destroy Earth's Starfleet Headquarters and complete your revenge against Spock.

starfleet_forces: Captain Kirk, Spock, McCoy, Scotty, Sulu, Uhura, Chekov
nero_forces: Narada (Romulan mining ship with advanced technology)

special_rules: Nero's tetryon weapons can bypass Enterprise shields
The wormhole is unstable and may close, stranding either side
Nero has future knowledge of Starfleet tactics and technology
Spock Prime aboard the Narada can be reasoned with or must be captured

victory_conditions.starfleet_victory: Disable the Narada and prevent Earth's destruction
victory_conditions.nero_victory: Destroy Earth's Starfleet Headquarters OR force the Enterprise to retreat
